reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT s.seller_id,AVG(r.score) AS average_score FROM sellers s LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.seller_id=s.seller_id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.listing_id=l.listing_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY s.seller_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT s.seller_id,(SELECT AVG(r.score) FROM listings l JOIN reviews r ON r.listing_id=l.listing_id WHERE l.seller_id=s.seller_id) AS average_score FROM sellers s ORDER BY s.seller_id
